preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line.strip()), int) and 1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdin is a single integer N where 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^9. The first line is T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5), followed by T lines of N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == T and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == str(max_value_for_N(int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1].strip()))) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case N (at position i+1 in stdin), the corresponding line in stdout is the maximum possible value of the permutation of integers from 1 to N, where the value is defined as the sum of (k XOR P_k) for k from 1 to N, and P is a permutation of 1..N. The output must exactly match the computed maximum value for each N.
Each line of stdout is a valid integer representing the maximum permutation value for the corresponding N.
